Acrobatics / Resist Trip (DEX)
Resist Trip: opposed Acrobatics(DEX), Armor Check Penalty; action error modifier+1; larger participant +4 per Size category (pp.352,361). Your Size bonus +0. Still Standing: +4 unnamed bonus to this skill check resisting Trip (p.66); this is not a dodge bonus. The GC resolves the opposed result, sprawled/flat-footed conditions, critical effects, final attacks and permitted counter-Trip sequence separately. Opposed response. Active. Armor Check Penalty.
